<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex07052025-05-1316-51-52" status="reviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Conclusive verses (?–93b7)"/>
                   <pb n="92a"/><pb n="92b"/><!--Folio 92ab missing-->
        
        <lg><l><pb n="93a"/><lb n="93a1"/> dul ba'i tshig rnaMs dad ldan skye bo'i <choice><corr>rnar</corr><sic>snar</sic></choice> snyan cing ||</l>
         <l>skye bo ngan gang mthong na snying la zug rnu skyed byed ngag ||</l>
         <l>legs par bshad pa'ang gzhan la phan par su zhig seMs ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">The words of those disciplined [in....] are sweet to the ear of faithful people. 
            Who would think that it is beneficial for others to explain correctly words that generate pain in the heart when seen by bad people.</note>
         
         <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex705-1104-2023-06-272" status="reviewed">
            <lg><l>yun ring brtson pas dkar po'i sa bon mthur ldan zhing ||</l> <l>skye dang skye <choice><reg>bar</reg><orig>ba‹r›</orig></choice> rab sbyang blo gros gsal gyur pa ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ref="db:3805" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">blo ldan khyu mchog chos rje chos kyi bla ma</rs>'i <lb n="93a2"/> gsung ||</l> <l>theg mchog don gsal byed pa dran phyir mngon bar bstus ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I have summarized, in order to remember the teaching of the Lord of Dharma Chos kyi bla ma, the wise excellent bull, that clarifies the meaning of the excellent vehicle, 
            Whose mind became clear through clarification in repeated births 
            And who has the power of the wholesome seed thanks to his long-term efforts.</note></seg>
  
         <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex705-1104-2023-06-29" status="reviewed"><lg><l>bsod naMs 'di yis skye bo dam pa de dang de ||</l> <l>bdud kyi tshogs bcom rkang gnyis gtso' bor gyur pa dang ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">bdag</rs> kyang de dag rjes su byang chub mchog thob nas ||</l> <l>'gro rnams zhi ba'i lam la rab du 'god gyur cig ||</l></lg><note type="translation">Trough these merits, may each and every excellent man become the best of the biped (i.e., a Buddha) who conquers the armies of demons, and
May I, too, obtain the excellent awakening after them, and
May then beings be established in the path of pacification.</note></seg>
         
        <lg> <l>gang dang gang dag mngon sangs rgyas pa'i <lb n="93a3"/> zhing mchog der ||</l>
         <l>blo dman rtogs pas dbul zhing <choice><corr>rnyed</corr><sic>snyed</sic></choice> la gdu ba dang ||</l>
         <l>chos dang gang zag mchog la sdang par zhugs pa'i || </l>
         <l>skye bo ngan ba'i tshogs kyis phyogs kun dben gyur cig ||</l></lg>
        <note type="translation">In each and every excellent field of complete awakening
May all directions be empty of the flocks of bad men
Who engage hatefuly towards the doctrine and the exellent persons,
Who are of inferior mind, poor in understanding and attached to obtaining (things).</note>
         
            <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex705-1104-2023-06-273" status="finalized">
           <lg>    <l>gzhan <choice><reg/><orig>{°}</orig></choice>ma pham chos rgyal dri myed pa sa <choice><reg>stengs</reg><orig>steng‹s›</orig></choice> 'dir ||</l> <l>byang chub shing dbang drung du mngon sangs rgyas pa na <choice><reg>||</reg><orig>‹¦›</orig></choice></l><l><rs type="person" ref="db:3831" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">chos kyi seng ge</rs> blo gsal grags pa'i nyi 'od kyis ||</l> <l><lb n="93a4"/> theg pa mchog la rmongs pa'i rab rib sel gyur cig ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">When the Unconquered by others (i.e. Maitreya as a future buddha), the King of Doctrine, the Stainless one, will have correctly awaken under the bodhi-tree king (in Bodhgayā), on the earth,
May the eye-disease (timira) of ignorance with regard to the excellent vehicle be dispelled by the glorious sun-rays of the clear-minded one, the Lion of the doctrine (Chos kyi seng ge).</note></seg>
            </seg></TEI>
